name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Lets both parties share confidential information for an agreed purpose while restricting its use and disclosure.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.default: Evaluating whether to enter into a business relationship with the other party.
fields.description: Why the parties are sharing confidential information, e.g. to discuss a possible joint venture; it may only be used for this.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the MNDA starts

fields.label: MNDA Term

options.label: Expires a number of years after the Effective Date

fields.description: The length of this MNDA

fields.label: MNDA Term (years)
fields.description: Years until the MNDA expires

fields.label: Term of Confidentiality

options.label: A number of years after the Effective Date

fields.description: How long Confidential Information is protected. Trade secrets stay protected for as long as they remain trade secrets.

fields.label: Term of Confidentiality (years)
fields.description: Years Confidential Information is protected

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The US state whose laws govern the MNDA, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Jurisdiction
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes, e.g. courts located in New Castle, DE

fields.label: MNDA Modifications
fields.description: Changes to the Standard Terms, if any

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: For selling and buying access to a cloud (SaaS) product: access and use, restrictions, fees, data, confidentiality, warranties, liability, indemnification and termination.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the Agreement starts

fields.label: Order Date
fields.description: The date of the Order Form

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.description: How long the Customer may use the Cloud Service, e.g. 1 year from the Order Date

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: What the Customer pays and when, e.g. $1,000 per month, invoiced monthly

fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
fields.description: Deadline to give notice of non-renewal, e.g. 30 days before the end of the current Subscription Period

fields.label: Technical Support
fields.description: The support the Provider gives, e.g. email support during business hours

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The US state whose laws govern the Agreement, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes, e.g. the state or federal courts located in New Castle, DE

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: Each party's maximum total liability, e.g. the fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims the Provider indemnifies against, e.g. claims that the Cloud Service infringes intellectual property rights

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims the Customer indemnifies against, e.g. claims arising from Customer Content

fields.label: DPA
fields.description: The Data Processing Agreement between the parties, if any

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Sets uptime and support response-time targets for a cloud service, and the service credits available when targets are missed. Supplements a Cloud Service Agreement.

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.description: The Subscription Period of the underlying Cloud Service Agreement, e.g. 1 year from the Order Date

fields.label: Target Uptime
fields.description: Minimum monthly availability of the Cloud Service, e.g. 99.9%

fields.label: Uptime Credit
fields.description: Credit when uptime falls below target, e.g. 10% of the monthly fees for each 0.1% below the Target Uptime

fields.label: Target Response Time
fields.description: How quickly the Provider responds to support requests, e.g. 4 business hours

fields.label: Response Time Credit
fields.description: Credit when the Target Response Time is missed, e.g. 5% of the monthly fees

fields.label: Support Channel
fields.description: Where to send support requests, e.g. support@provider.com

fields.label: Scheduled Downtime
fields.description: Planned maintenance windows that do not count against uptime, e.g. Sundays 2-4am UTC with 48 hours' notice

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Governs how a provider processes customer personal data as a processor or subprocessor: security, subprocessors, data subject requests, breach notification and international transfers under GDPR and UK law.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The main agreement this DPA supplements, e.g. the Cloud Service Agreement between the parties dated January 1, 2026

fields.label: Nature and Purpose of Processing
fields.description: What the Provider does with personal data and why, e.g. providing the Cloud Service under the Agreement

fields.label: Duration of Processing
fields.description: How long processing lasts, e.g. the term of the Agreement

fields.label: Categories of Data Subjects
fields.description: Whose personal data is processed, e.g. Customer's employees and end users

fields.label: Categories of Personal Data
fields.description: What kinds of personal data, e.g. names, email addresses and usage data

fields.label: Special Category Data
fields.description: Sensitive data such as health or biometric data, if any

fields.label: Special Category Data Restrictions or Safeguards
fields.description: Extra protections for Special Category Data, if any

fields.label: Frequency of Transfer
fields.description: How often data is transferred, e.g. continuous

fields.label: Approved Subprocessors
fields.description: Subprocessors the Customer approves, e.g. AWS (hosting), or a link to the Provider's list

fields.label: Provider Security Contact
fields.description: Who to contact about security matters, e.g. security@provider.com

fields.label: Security Policy
fields.description: The security standard the Provider is audited against, e.g. SOC 2 Type II

fields.label: Governing Member State
fields.description: The EU member state whose laws govern the EEA Standard Contractual Clauses, e.g. Ireland

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: For an early-access program where a partner gets early access to a product and gives feedback to the provider: program participation, feedback ownership, confidentiality and term.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the Agreement starts

fields.label: Term
fields.description: How long the program lasts, e.g. 6 months from the Effective Date

fields.label: Program
fields.description: What the Partner does in the program, e.g. use the beta product and join a monthly feedback call

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: What the Partner pays, if anything

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The US state whose laws govern the Agreement, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes, e.g. the state or federal courts located in New Castle, DE

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: For engaging a provider to perform services and produce deliverables under a Statement of Work: fees, intellectual property, confidentiality, warranties, liability and termination.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the Agreement starts

fields.label: Deliverables
fields.description: The services and deliverables in the first Statement of Work

fields.label: SOW Term
fields.description: How long the Statement of Work lasts, e.g. 3 months from the Effective Date

fields.label: Fees
fields.description: What the Customer pays for the Statement of Work, e.g. $20,000, half upfront and half on delivery

fields.label: Payment Period
fields.description: How long the Customer has to pay an invoice, e.g. 30 days

fields.label: Customer Obligations
fields.description: What the Customer must provide, e.g. timely access to staff and systems

fields.label: Rejection Period
fields.description: How long the Customer has to reject a Deliverable, e.g. 10 business days

fields.label: Resubmission Period
fields.description: How long the Provider has to fix a rejected Deliverable, e.g. 10 business days

fields.label: Time of Assignment
fields.description: When ownership of Deliverables passes to the Customer, e.g. on payment of the related Fees

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The US state whose laws govern the Agreement, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes, e.g. the state or federal courts located in New Castle, DE

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: Each party's maximum total liability, e.g. the fees paid or payable in the 12 months before the claim

fields.label: Increased Claims
fields.description: Claims subject to a higher liability cap, e.g. breaches of confidentiality

fields.label: Increased Cap Amount
fields.description: The higher cap for Increased Claims, e.g. 3 times the General Cap Amount

fields.label: Unlimited Claims
fields.description: Claims with no liability cap, e.g. fraud or gross negligence

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims the Provider indemnifies against, e.g. claims that the Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims the Customer indemnifies against, e.g. claims arising from materials the Customer provides

fields.label: Additional Warranties
fields.description: Warranties beyond the Standard Terms, if any

fields.label: Customer Policies
fields.description: Customer policies the Provider must follow, e.g. the Customer's vendor code of conduct

fields.label: Security Policy
fields.description: Security requirements the Provider must meet, if any

fields.label: Insurance Minimums
fields.description: Insurance each party must carry, e.g. $1,000,000 general liability

fields.label: DPA
fields.description: The Data Processing Agreement between the parties, if any

name: Partnership Agreement
description: For a business partnership in which each party performs agreed obligations: payment, a trademark license, privacy, escalation, confidentiality, liability and termination.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the Agreement starts

fields.label: End Date
fields.description: When the partnership ends, e.g. 1 year after the Effective Date

fields.label: Obligations
fields.description: What each party commits to do, e.g. the Partner resells the Company's product and the Company provides sales training

fields.label: Territory
fields.description: Where the parties may use each other's brands, e.g. the United States

fields.label: Payment Schedule
fields.description: Fees and when they are paid, e.g. 20% of net revenue, paid quarterly

fields.label: Payment Process
fields.description: How invoices are issued and paid, e.g. invoiced quarterly, due within 30 days

fields.label: Brand Guidelines
fields.description: Rules for using each party's brand, e.g. a link to the brand guidelines

fields.label: Additional Warranties
fields.description: Warranties beyond the Standard Terms, if any

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The US state whose laws govern the Agreement, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes, e.g. the state or federal courts located in New Castle, DE

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: Each party's maximum total liability, e.g. the amounts paid under the Agreement in the 12 months before the claim

fields.label: Increased Claims
fields.description: Claims subject to a higher liability cap, e.g. breaches of confidentiality

fields.label: Increased Cap Amount
fields.description: The higher cap for Increased Claims, e.g. 3 times the General Cap Amount

fields.label: Unlimited Claims
fields.description: Claims with no liability cap, e.g. fraud or gross negligence

fields.label: Company Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims the Company indemnifies against, if any

fields.label: Partner Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims the Partner indemnifies against, if any

fields.label: DPA
fields.description: The Data Processing Agreement between the parties, if any

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Required under HIPAA when a provider handles protected health information (PHI) for a covered entity: permitted uses, safeguards, breach reporting and return of PHI.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The main agreement under which the Provider handles PHI, e.g. the Cloud Service Agreement between the parties dated January 1, 2026

fields.label: BAA Effective Date
fields.description: The date the BAA starts

fields.label: Breach Notification Period
fields.description: How quickly the Provider reports a breach, e.g. 5 business days after discovery

fields.label: Limitations
fields.description: Restrictions on disclosing PHI to subcontractors or offshore, if any

name: Software License Agreement

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.description: How long the license lasts, e.g. 1 year from the Order Date

fields.label: Permitted Uses

fields.label: License Limits

fields.label: Fees

fields.label: Payment Process

fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
fields.description: Deadline to give notice of non-renewal, e.g. 30 days before the end of the current Subscription Period

fields.label: Warranty Period

fields.label: Deletion Procedure

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The US state whose laws govern the Agreement, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts

fields.label: General Cap Amount

fields.label: Increased Claims

fields.label: Unlimited Claims

fields.description: Third-party claims the Provider indemnifies against, e.g. claims that the Software infringes intellectual property rights

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.description: Third-party claims the Customer indemnifies against, e.g. claims arising from the Customer's misuse of the Software

fields.label: Additional Warranties

name: Pilot Agreement
description: For a short-term trial that lets a prospective customer evaluate a product before committing to a full commercial agreement, with limited scope and easy termination.

fields.label: Effective Date
fields.description: The date the Agreement starts

fields.label: Pilot Period
fields.description: How long the Customer may evaluate the Product, e.g. 30 days from the Effective Date

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.description: Each party's maximum total liability, e.g. $10,000

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.description: The US state whose laws govern the Agreement, e.g. Delaware

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.description: The courts that hear disputes, e.g. the state or federal courts located in New Castle, DE

name: AI Addendum
description: Addendum to a commercial agreement covering the provider's AI services: rights in customer input and generated output, restrictions on training models with customer data, and related disclaimers.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.description: The commercial agreement this addendum supplements, e.g. the Cloud Service Agreement between the parties dated January 1, 2026

fields.label: Training Data
fields.description: Customer data the Provider may train models on; leave empty if training is not allowed

fields.label: Training Purposes
fields.description: What training on Training Data may be for, e.g. improving the Provider's models for all customers

fields.label: Training Restrictions
fields.description: Conditions on training, e.g. data must be de-identified first

fields.label: Improvement Restrictions
fields.description: Limits on using Input and Output to improve the AI Services, if any
